correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 32-dimensional squarefree group algebra in characteristic two and classified each leading degree, including the rank-four alternating quadratic normal form (rank 12), decomposable quadratic normal form ab+gamma*cde (ranks 8 and 10), nonzero cubic alternating ranks (4,6), and linear/unit/socle cases. For a decomposable quadratic, the unique degree-three complement coefficient is zero for q^9 cubic choices, nonzero for (q-1)q^9; adjoining six quartic/quintic coefficients yields Bq^15 and B(q-1)q^15. Other terms follow Gaussian bivector counts and 2^5 dimension; all coefficients sum to q^32. Independently constructed original binary 32x32 multiplication ranks for 0,1,x_1,ab,ab+cde,ab+cd,abc,abcd,abcde and all 1024 binary quadratic forms: rank-8 155, rank-12 868 and zero 1. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace normal-form proof.

value.rationale: Five elementary involutive generators are the first natural exterior-algebra size where cubic corrections change multiplication rank at fixed quadratic principal symbol. A complete rank and Jordan-block frequency distribution across all elements is a nontrivial, readily reusable benchmark for nilpotent group algebra, principal-ideal and cohomological calculations. Counts ranks of natural operators rather than an arbitrary sample, while not claiming arbitrary generator number.

limitations: No claim that rank-8/10 cubic perturbation witness is historically new; it appears in previously published work.
No enumeration of distinct principal ideals or n>5; all finite fields q powers of two only.
Unknown equivalent full-polynomial result remains best-of-knowledge priority risk.
